WITH ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss 
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.s_store_id, ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, 0 as return_amt, 0 as net_loss 
        FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        WHERE dd.d_week_seq = 53 AND dd.d_year = 2001
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, 0 as sales_price, 0 as profit, -sr.sr_return_amt as return_amt, -sr.sr_net_loss as net_loss 
        FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim dd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        WHERE dd.d_week_seq = 53 AND dd.d_year = 2001
    ) salesreturns 
    GROUP BY s_store_id
)
SELECT 'store' AS channel, CAST('store' || s_store_id AS VARCHAR(50)) AS id, sales, profit, returns, profit_loss 
FROM ssr
ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100
